findings.finding: The inventory mechanism ('enumerate mutating verbs from _WRITES_FULL / _DISPATCH_PRIMARY') is wrong for _DISPATCH_PRIMARY: that frozenset is a router partition, not a write set. It unions in pure reads (show/list/search/deps/ready/next-batch/session-logs/validate) and init/metrics. Enumerating 'mutating verbs' from it would either over-include reads (attaching confirmation lines to read commands) or force the implementer to hand-filter — defeating the plan's own 'not a hand list' intent.
findings.location: Plan step 6 + AC line 1 ('enumerated from the dispatch write-set')
scenarios: Implementer iterates _DISPATCH_PRIMARY and prints 'confirmation' lines on show/list/search
findings.suggested_fix: Enumerate from _WRITES_FULL | _LIFECYCLE | _COMPACT (and explicitly list delete/import if intended), not _DISPATCH_PRIMARY.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Specify that --quiet/-q is pre-extracted above both dispatch routes (mirroring _extract_allow_secret) so the positional-only leaf verbs (comment/tag/untag/archive) accept it instead of raising the no-options usage error.
evidence: src/rebar/_commands/__init__.py:201-211 _split_positionals rejects any leading-'-' token as 'unrecognised option ... accepts no options' (returncode 2)
src/rebar/_commands/__init__.py:121-140 _extract_allow_secret pre-extracts a flag BEFORE both dispatch routes precisely for this reason
src/rebar/_engine_support/output.py:88 parse_output is only invoked by the _ARGV_REGISTRY composer route, not the positional _REGISTRY verbs
findings.finding: The positional-only leaf verbs (comment, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands) route through _REGISTRY, which treats ANY option-looking token as a loud usage error and never calls parse_output. A new global --quiet/-q flag will therefore usage-error on exactly these verbs unless it is pre-extracted ahead of _split_positionals (the way --allow-secret-pattern is handled by _extract_allow_secret). The plan states '--quiet' as a flat global without addressing this parse ordering.
findings.location: Plan step 4 (--quiet/-q global flag) + AC line 4
scenarios: `rebar tag <id> <tag> -q` usage-errors instead of suppressing the confirmation
